00046 PinkNoiseUGenInternal::PinkNoiseUGenInternal() throw()
00047 :   UGenInternal(NoInputs),
00048     //random((unsigned int)this * 123463463UL + 423815L + rand(19469146))
00049     random(rand(0x7fffffff))
00050 {   
00051     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00052     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00053     
00054     for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) 
00055     {
00056         unsigned long r = Ran088::next(s1, s2, s3) >> 13;
00057         total += r;
00058         dice[i] = r;
00059     }   
00060     
00061     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00062     
00063     initValue(random.nextBiFloat());
00064 }
00065 
00066 void PinkNoiseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00067 {
00068     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00069     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00070     
00071     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00072     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00073     
00074     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00075     {
00076         unsigned long counter = Ran088::next(s1, s2, s3);
00077         unsigned long newrand = counter >> 13;
00078         int k = Bits::countTrailingZeros(counter) & 15; 
00079         unsigned long prevrand = dice[k]; 
00080         dice[k] = newrand; 
00081         total += (newrand - prevrand); 
00082         newrand = Ran088::next(s1,s2,s3) >> 13;
00083         Element val;
00084         val.u = (total + newrand) | 0x40000000;
00085         *outputSamples++ = (val.f - 3.f);
00086     }
00087     
00088     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00089 }
00090 
00091 PinkNoise::PinkNoise() throw()
00092 {
00093     initInternal(1);
00094     internalUGens[0] = new PinkNoiseUGenInternal();
00095 }
